synth.notes:
Two modes: BLOCK (cyan blocks move 4px, mirrored in x across the centre, blocked by markers/their half/board) and ARMED (clicking a marker activates it and arms the players; arrows move only the active marker; clicking a player goes back to BLOCK).
Step bar: wall_0 strips at the top-right and bottom-left, width floor(3(c+1)/7). c is a hidden step counter kept only while the bar width matches.
Names: block_left/right take indices 0,1, then the other objects are indexed by sorting on (y,x); type_color_idx; only cyan blocks carry pixels.
Action 5 and clicks with no effect are no-ops apart from the counter.
Open: 5 failures (t3-5 block_left can't move up at (14,42); t11 marker can't move to (7,19); t18 marker can't move to (39,15)). These look like an invisible maze with no pixels in the schema; not modelled.
